name: extension-hours-formula
prompt: What's the exact formula this model uses to calculate estimated hours per extension for a TYPO3 LTS upgrade?

assertions.description: Cites the compound formula: extension_hours = baseline × Π(multipliers) × rector_discount × calibration
Includes the Rector coverage discount factor in the formula
Includes the team calibration factor in the formula

name: tsfe-removal-multiplier
prompt: An extension in our v13 to v14.3 TYPO3 upgrade reads $GLOBALS['TSFE'] directly. What risk multiplier applies and why?

assertions.description: Cites the exact x1.3 multiplier for TypoScriptFrontendController removal
Names the removed class as the source of the multiplier

name: fluid5-strict-vh-multiplier
prompt: We have several custom Fluid ViewHelpers without typed arguments. What multiplier does that add for a v14.3 upgrade?

assertions.description: Cites the exact x1.2 Fluid 5 strict ViewHelper typing multiplier
Names the specific v14 breaking change driving the multiplier

name: compound-multipliers-are-multiplicative
prompt: This extension triggers both the Fluid 5 strict ViewHelper factor and the TSFE removal factor. Do these two multipliers add together or multiply?

assertions.description: States multipliers are multiplicative, not additive -- an easy-to-get-wrong modeling detail
References both specific factor values together to show how they compound

name: v13-to-v14-baseline-hours
prompt: Give me a rough hour range for upgrading one of our own extensions (with Rector available) from v13 to v14.3 LTS, before any team calibration is applied.

assertions.description: Cites the 4-8h baseline for the v13 -> v14.3 own-extension-with-Rector path
Notes the baseline still needs the team calibration multiplier applied

name: rector-discount-v14
prompt: How many Rector rules exist for the TYPO3 v14 migration, and how much time do they save compared to hand-coding the same fixes?

assertions.description: Cites the exact count of 47 v14 Rector rules
Cites the x0.80-0.85 auto-fix discount factor

name: stale-third-party-extra-hours
prompt: One of the extensions we depend on for v13 to v14.3 is stale, unmaintained, third-party code with no Rector coverage plan. How does that change the estimate versus our own extensions?

assertions.description: Cites the +2-4h addition for the stale third-party path at v13 -> v14.3
Names the stale/third-party category explicitly

name: hashservice-removal-multiplier
prompt: We call TYPO3's Extbase HashService directly in a few places. What's the risk multiplier for that on a v14.3 upgrade?

assertions.description: Cites the exact x1.1 HashService removal multiplier
Names HashService as the trigger

name: asset-concat-removal-multiplier
prompt: Our site still relies on config.concatenateCss and config.concatenateJs in TypoScript. What does that mean for the v14.3 estimate?

assertions.description: Cites the exact x1.2 asset concat/compression removal multiplier
Names the required replacement -- an external build tool

name: seven-phase-workflow-order
prompt: What are the phases of a proper TYPO3 upgrade effort assessment, in order?

assertions.description: Names Discovery as an early phase
Names extension Classification as a phase
Names risk calculation as a phase

name: post-upgrade-wizard-extra-hours
prompt: A customer's site sat on v14.2 for a while before we finish the v14.3 upgrade. Is there any extra effort to budget beyond the normal extension work?

assertions.description: Cites the +0.5-1h post-upgrade wizard effort tied to core issue #109585, specific to projects that transited v14.2
Names the post-upgrade wizard as the source of the extra effort

name: skip-version-vs-incremental
prompt: Should we jump straight from v11 to v14, or go through v12 and v13 first? What does this model help decide?

assertions.description: Names the skip-version decision this model explicitly supports
Contrasts against the incremental (step-by-step LTS) path

name: companion-skill-handoff-for-actual-upgrade
prompt: We finished the effort estimate for the v14.3 upgrade -- which skill actually performs the extension code upgrade itself?

assertions.description: Names the companion skill that performs the actual code upgrade; this model is estimation-only
Clarifies this skill's own scope is effort estimation, not the upgrade itself

name: calibration-factor-range
prompt: We've never tracked historical upgrade hours before. What calibration factor should we multiply the baseline by?

assertions.description: Cites the typical 0.6-1.4 calibration factor range for teams without tuned historical data
Recommends deriving the factor from the team's own historical data once available

name: form-framework-hooks-conditional
prompt: Does the EXT:form hook-removal multiplier apply to every extension in our v14.3 upgrade, or only some?

assertions.description: Correctly scopes the EXT:form hook-removal multiplier to extensions that actually use the form framework, not all extensions
Cites the x1.05-1.2 range for the EXT:form hook removal factor
